name: Sinkhole

source.title: Pathfinder Bounty #2: Blood of the Beautiful

disable: DC 12 Nature check to remove the covering foliage

items.name: Fall
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks onto the sinkhole

---

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (10 bludgeoning damage). That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling.

text: An assortment of leaves and loose dirt cover a sudden drop in elevation.
